name: motion-skills
description: 56 open-source skills that teach your AI coding agent to make motion graphics, animation & video — kinetic typography, data-viz, explainers, TikTok/Reels, WebGL, Manim. 19 installable packs. By iart.ai, the AI motion agent.
readme: 56 open-source skills that teach your AI coding agent to make motion graphics, animation, and video — kinetic typography, data-driven charts, explainers, TikTok / Reels, 3D & WebGL, math animation, generative illustration, code-drawn canvas animation, transparent lower thirds, b-roll for talking-head videos, AI presenter films, and web motion. Nineteen installable packs. Install one, and your agent just knows how.
